entry.title: Add importprivkeys RPC
entry.summary:
The Core Wallet Migration Tools have been enhanced to support a broader range of address types through the new combo-import feature, as outlined in the original proposal titled "Add importprivkeys RPC," available for review [here](https://gist.github.com/blocktraveler/3e6198c698a272bd8b13b16e0f13d390). This update aims to bolster the functionality and flexibility of the tools, facilitating a more comprehensive approach to wallet management. The tools themselves can be accessed [here](https://github.com/namecoin-dev/Core-Wallet-Migration-Tools).
Additionally, the release of the Core Wallet Maintenance Tools marks a significant advancement in wallet management technology, specifically tailored for both Bitcoin and Namecoin. Among the various features of these tools is a script dedicated to extracting private keys from descriptors. Originally developed for Namecoin, this tool has now been made publicly available due to popular demand, as indicated on [this GitHub issue](https://github.com/namecoin-dev/Core-Wallet-Migration-Tools/issues/2). For those interested, the tools are hosted on GitHub [here](https://github.com/namecoin-dev/Core-Wallet-Maintenance-Tools/tree/main/Bitcoin).
These developments reflect ongoing efforts to enhance cryptocurrency wallet infrastructure by providing robust tools that support efficient management and maintenance of digital assets across different cryptocurrencies.
